column1: Operating Direct Reduced Iron Capacity (TTPA) by Reductant Type
Global Iron and Steel Tracker, September 2026 (V1)
This data is based on the Global Iron and Steel Tracker, updated March 2026 with limited quarterly updates performed in June and September 2026 (Download here)
Units of measurement: thousand tonnes per annum (ttpa)
1) Total operating capacity excludes plants that are in development (announced/construction) or idled (retired/mothballed/cancelled)
2) Only reductants reflected in the operating capacity tracked in the GIST are included in this table.
